title.description: Short title shown on the calendar.

startsAt.description: Start time as an ISO 8601 timestamp with a UTC offset.

endsAt.description: End time as an ISO 8601 timestamp with a UTC offset. Must be after startsAt.

date.description: Calendar date the event belongs to (YYYY-MM-DD).

attendees.description: Email addresses of people to invite.

reminderMinutes.description: Minutes before the start to send a reminder.
